services.desc: Dauphin Island Fishing - If you’re itching to cast a line, Dauphin Island has ample opportunities for fishing. With miles of shoreline and access to both inshore and offshore fishing, the island attracts anglers of all skill levels. Whether you prefer surfcasting from the beach or chartering a boat for deep sea fishing, there’s no shortage of options. As you reel in your catch, take in the scenery of the Gulf of Mexico and the Mississippi Sound. If you’re looking to go fishing while visiting Dauphin Island, then you’re in for a treat!
